title: Webhook Triggers Settings
description: Trigger external webhooks from YouTrack events. Add one row per event, then list the endpoints it is delivered to — each endpoint carries its own token. A row with event "All Events" fans out to every event type.

headerName.title: Header name
headerName.description: The HTTP header name that carries each trigger's token in outgoing requests

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: One row per event. Each row holds the endpoints that event is delivered to, and each endpoint carries its own token.

event.title: Event
event.description: The YouTrack event that fires this webhook

endpoints.title: Endpoints
endpoints.description: Every endpoint of this trigger is called with its own token, so one compromised receiver never exposes the others.

url.title: URL
url.description: The webhook endpoint. HTTPS strongly recommended — the token is sent with every request.

secret.title: Token
secret.description: Shared secret sent to this endpoint in the configured header. Must be at least 32 characters long. Rotate immediately if the endpoint is decommissioned or a compromise is suspected.
